description: Raw process observations and sequencing results from North Water's saline wastewater plant support a study of sequence-informed activated-sludge modelling. This resource is provided by Mohamad Agung Prawira Negara. Coverage is site as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The article interpolates the observations into a daily dataset; users must distinguish raw values from derived daily values. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
